description: Ministry of Education - Order made under Section 27(1), Faculty of Indigenous Medicine University of Colombo - Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order under Section 27(1) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments at the University of Colombo. While it mentions a State Minister (Dr. Suren Raghavan), this is only in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation, not making government personnel or structural changes. The core content is about modifying legal/regulatory frameworks governing university administration, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
